payload.query: Can I wear my suede Chelsea boots in the rain?

args.text: No, you should avoid wearing suede Chelsea boots in rain, slush, or snow because suede is easily stained by water and salt [shoe-care#1]. While a suede protector spray can reduce water damage, it does not make the suede waterproof [shoe-care#1].
